# OrbitBoard — Practical Online Tools for Work & Life

OrbitBoard is a free online utility platform for practical tools across career, finance, everyday tasks, developer workflows, PDFs, documents and file utilities.

## Core categories
- Career — salary, gratuity, experience and job-related calculators
- Finance — EMI, GST, SIP and income-tax estimators
- Everyday — converters, PDF tools, image tools and file utilities
- Developer — JSON, CSV, XML, Base64, JWT, URL and timestamp tools

## Product principles
- Core tools are available without an account.
- Many file and data tools process content directly in the browser.
- Tools are designed to provide practical results quickly.
- OrbitBoard is expanding toward live information and other utility experiences.

## Navigation
- [Home](https://orbitboard.in/) — OrbitBoard home
- [All tools](https://orbitboard.in/tools) — searchable tool catalogue
- [Tool pages](https://orbitboard.in/tools/) — individual tools under the /tools/ path

## Technology
- Frontend: React + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Backend services: Supabase
- Hosting: Vercel
